topic: Finnish demographics data and partner company access
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered updates regarding the demographic data query. [p1] reported that while they successfully integrated Finnish demographics, they struggled to fix a specific SQL array function (`select arraySum(arrayMap(x -> x.1*x.2, arrayZip([], [])))`) due to issues with handling empty arrays in ClickHouse.

[p1] noted that the current version of the data only works for Finland, and one element is commented out in the query. The Danish data has been excluded. [p1] also managed to integrate partner company information, which was previously blank for general users.
decisions: The demographic data query currently functions only for Finland.
